name: The Prince of Miurna (deceased)
description: Eldest son of [[Cargal IV]]. Eloped with the [[Sultana of Caryes]] and was assassinated with her; by the folk story, they left [[Lost Heir|a child]]. Now almost mythic across the [[Greater Lands]].

name: The Sultana of Caryes (deceased)
description: Heir to [[Caryes]] and, through her mother, to the [[group/realm-aphemenosta|Rock of Aphemenosta]] and the [[Emirate of Ievure]]. Assassinated with the [[Prince of Miurna|Prince]]; by the folk story, they left [[Lost Heir|a child]].

name: The Lost Heir
description: In folk stories, the child of the [[Prince of Miurna|Prince]] and the [[Sultana of Caryes|Sultana]], who survived the assassination. Widely held a fable: across every faction the accepted belief is that the Prince died childless or, if there was a baby, that it died with him. Even the idea is politically dangerous to every faction, because it is true that popular sentiment would drive the remaining states to federate under a true heir of the couple.

name: The Emir of Ievure
description: The [[Sultana of Caryes|Sultana]]'s younger brother; holds the [[Emirate of Ievure|Emirate]].

name: Incentus I, Lord of the Dells
description: His ideals and writings form a philosophical core of [[Order of the White Raven|White Raven]] philosophy and, in rare and illicit tomes, of thaumaturgy.

name: Cargal IV (deceased)
description: King of the [[Union of the Kingdoms]]. The loss of his eldest son, the [[Prince of Miurna]], drove him mad (the [[Madness of Cargal IV]]); after his death his younger sons [[Ceoin Miurna|Ceoin]] and [[Alba Miurna|Alba]] contested the throne and the Union split apart.

name: Ceoin Miurna
description: King of Leantis. Second son of [[Cargal IV]], and first in line after the [[Prince of Miurna|Prince]] by primogeniture. Won the backing of the Western kingdoms by arguing that the Union should have many voices and moving his putative throne to the West; the [[Treaty of Sinte]] made his kingdom a recognised state. Brother and enemy of [[Alba Miurna|Alba]] in the [[Brotherly War]].

name: Alba Miurna
description: King of Miurna. Third son of [[Cargal IV]], widely seen as the more effective statesman; won most of the elders of the court and his uncle [[Lord Read of the Leantain Reach|Lord Read]] to his claim, and claimed the throne of the Union in the capital. A diplomat, he argues convincingly abroad that the Union was not, and is not, a military threat to the balance of power in the [[Greater Lands]]. Brother and enemy of [[Ceoin Miurna|Ceoin]] in the [[Brotherly War]].

name: Lord Read of the Leantain Reach
description: Brother of the late [[Cargal IV]], holding the [[Leantain Reach]]. He backed his nephew [[Alba Miurna|Alba]] in the succession. Under the older custom of brother before son he could have claimed the throne himself, so his support lent Alba a legitimacy that his elder brother's claim by primogeniture could not simply outweigh.

name: Caruman II
description: Sultan of [[group/realm-astina|Astina]]. A well-liked and astute, if uninventive, ruler: the archetypal patriarch of his nation, a liberal enjoyer of wine, delicacies and companions, who met his duties with aplomb. In late middle age a mortal sickness took hold of him and he withdrew to his offices, then to his chamber in [[the Harem]]. Now 147, he has not been seen in almost a century, yet from his deathbed he acts in matters of state more incisively than in his prime. For all his wives he has no legitimate heir, a mystery of its own.
